prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 20:9 overscan master candidate for a game GUI facility background in the Element Maze JRPG static prototype. Primary request: Create an Earth-region weapon workshop / forge background in Japanese visual novel fantasy CG style, anime-style JRPG facility art, for later cropping to a 1672x941 GUI background. Scene/backdrop: A hot Earth-region quarry forge built into carved leyline stone and dark timber under a forest canopy. Interior has a stone anvil, green-gold leyline furnace, mineral ingots, geode cores, vine-bound weapon racks, root-fiber tool wraps, blackened brass clamps, clay crucibles, cooling troughs, mossy stone walls, hanging dried herbs for tempering oil, and amber resin lamps. The forge should feel hot, smoky, and practical, with forest-quarry identity, not a winter forge, not a pure cave, and not a flat wall. Preserve readable left and middle background depth for GUI panels. Subject: Gray, adult male elf-like weaponsmith, visual-only candidate NPC. Make him clearly distinct from the Earth guild liaison: late 30s, lean strong build, angular but soft Japanese VN face, pointed ears visible, tan skin, short swept-back ash-brown hair tied in a small low knot, clean-shaven or very light stubble only, focused craftsman expression. He wears conservative hot-climate forge clothing: sleeveless dark linen work shirt with high chest coverage, moss-brown leather apron, forearm wraps, tool belt, small brass and stone clips, no heavy coat, no winter fur, no heroic armor. He is medium-close half-body in the right foreground, one hand holding tongs or a half-finished blade on the anvil, face in the upper-right safe zone with breathing room from the image edge, hands and forge tool surface visible. Style/medium: polished 2D anime fantasy game background, Japanese visual novel facility CG, clean elegant linework, mature painterly JRPG texture, soft but distinct male facial features, detailed but not cluttered. Composition/framing: extra-wide 20:9 landscape overscan. Design the central 80% so it can crop cleanly to 16:9. Keep Gray medium-close on the right or center-right, face around x 68%-82% and y 12%-32% of the eventual 16:9 crop, not cropped. Preserve usable left/middle space for workshop tabs and detail panels. Lower anvil, hands, blade, and tools may be partly hidden by GUI panels; face and core torso must remain safe. Lighting/mood: hot practical quarry forge, amber resin lamps, green-gold leyline furnace glow, warm smoke, cool filtered forest light from left windows, grounded workshop atmosphere. Color palette: dark timber brown, moss green, black iron, warm amber, muted gold-green, clay terracotta, charcoal, tan leather. Materials/textures: carved quarry stone, moss, roots, hot metal, brass clamps, clay crucibles, dark timber, leather apron, linen, mineral crystals, geodes, tool scratches, soot. Constraints: no in-image text, no readable signs, no UI panels, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark, no captions.
